release_identity.manifest_binding: This record is included and hashed by release/delivery-manifest.json; no self-referential manifest hash is stored here.

usb_impedance.route_geometry_source: Current native PCB: USB_DP_CONN/USB_DM_CONN and USB_DP/USB_DM
required_evidence: Stack-up-specific field-solver result for actual widths, pair gaps, copper and reference layers
Assembled DATA-port enumeration and signal-integrity test
Final-board hash and every inventory coordinate included in fabrication instruction
Supplier confirms filled/capped process rather than tenting/mask plugging
First article shows planar plated caps and acceptable solder joints

usb_hole_exceptions.scope: Engineering-review exception only; no automatic manufacturing waiver

inspect: J1 PWR / J10 DATA identity and plug access
J2 pin 1 and A1/A2/B1/B2 correspondence to connector-harnesses.md
J3 pin 1 VMOTOR and pin 2 BRAKE_RETURN; pin 2 must not be labelled GND
PD programming VREF/GND/SDA/SCL/ISO service contact identity
critical_markings.criteria: No required marking removed, clipped or made ambiguous by mask, solder, tall components or assembly; use an approved durable enclosure/harness label if board marking is inaccessible. Review actual fabrication plots and first article.

closure_rule: Every applicable acceptance requires a named reviewer and evidence for the exact release. CAD/tests cannot set supplier or physical acceptance to true.
